CapabilityTHE FULL LIST

What we take on.

Everything below happens in our own workshop in Al Sena'a. Nothing is sublet, so nothing gets lost between two shops blaming each other.

01Dyno tuning & mapping Custom maps written on our rollers for standalone ECUs, piggyback systems and factory remaps. Logged, verified and handed over with the graph. 02Performance parts supply 20 categories across 34 authorised brands. If it makes power, holds power or stops it, we source it genuine and warrantied. 03Engine building Forged bottom ends, head work, valvetrain and blueprinting — built to survive the power you asked for. 04Forced induction Turbo and supercharger conversions, manifold and intercooling design, boost control and fuelling to match. 05Fabrication Exhaust systems, intakes, charge piping and hard lines fabricated in-house to fit your car properly. 06Suspension & brakes Coilovers, geometry, bushings, big-brake kits and pads — set up for how and where you actually drive. 07Diagnostics & health checks Full scan, compression and leak-down before you spend money on power. Find the fault first. 08Build consultation Free. Tell us the goal and the budget and we'll map the stages honestly — including when to stop.
